decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6598. Series context: trend strength 0.9744 and seasonal strength 0.0102; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.392); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.51.
